notes.title: Sudoku Killer new release date - October 19
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/861270/Sudoku_Killer/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30909774/efd5a4989eedecffd57a28820e58e569ac70d736.png[/img][/url]

Greetings :)

We decided to postpone Sudoku Killer for a few weeks, it'll be available on [h1]Friday, [b]October 19[/b], wishlist to stay updated![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/861270/Sudoku_Killer/

This will be the hardest Sudoku of all our Sudoku series, so prepare yourself. [b]100[/b] killer levels will bring you hours of brain exercises. Wish you all good luck and have a great time playing our new game.

[h1]Reviews are really important for us[/h1]
Positive. Negative. Whatever. We encourage you to write any thoughts you have about our games, you will make them better. Even few words will be enough. This is especially critical during launch week, so do not hesitate!

[h1]Sudoku Bundle[/h1]
Sudoku Killer from launch date will be a part of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6448/Sudoku_Universe_Bundle/]Sudoku Bundle[/url] (35% OFF), so all owners of Sudoku Universe or Jigsaw will be able to get it really cheap. Or it's just good chance to buy all of them if you haven't played any. They are really good :)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6448/Sudoku_Universe_Bundle/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32988905/5b060570d0a06a1d2ab414f0e39895e7ce13b4d8.png[/img][/url]

Thanks for your attention and support.

[i]Your best,
Nestor from Konstructors[/i]

notes.title: My apologies, Lines Infinite release & giveaway.
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!

First of all, I want to thank you all for support, all who liked and disliked a game. Both positive and negative feedback is very appreciated and it will affect my future releases.

I've just released Lines sequel - [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/733050/Lines_Infinite_by_Nestor_Yavorskyy/][b]Lines Infinite[/b][/url]. 
It contains 99 different-shaped levels of  and random level generator, which turns on after completing all available levels. New color themes, fullscreen mode button, hope you'll like the game.

I was very sad while reading all "achievement spam game" comments. 
I didn't really want to abuse a system, just wanted to make few people happier. 

As promised, I'll add new free levels and achievements (with every comment I got) in Lines Free & Lines and that's all. Sorry for everyone, who got mad because of this move.

In new Lines, I'll limit achievements to 100. 97 for completing first 97 levels + 3 for playing with random generator.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/733050/Lines_Infinite_by_Nestor_Yavorskyy/

Get your copy of Lines right now. Base price - [b]$0.99[/b], launch discount - 15%.

You should try your luck in [url=https://twitter.com/nestoryavorskyy/status/934208283614826496][b]Giveaway[/b][/url].
10 winners will get their key in 3 days.

Best regards,
Nestor Yavorskyy

notes.title: Minor update - Hotkeys, color theme switch, 32-bit support, bug fixes.
notes.notes:
[h1]- Hotkeys[/h1]
[b]C[/b] - switch color theme.
[b]L[/b] - lock/unlock color theme (if you want to play always with one pre-selected theme).
[b]M[/b] - music on/off.
[b]S[/b] - sounds on/off.
[b]Q[/b] - quit from level (if on level screen) / game (if on level selection screen).

[h1]- Windows/Mac/Linux 32-bit support[/h1]

[h1]- Removed Steam overlay opening[/h1]

[h1]- Fixed cursor moving on Linux[/h1]

[h1]- Fixed Linux launch bug[/h1] If still not working, find executable on your hard drive and do "chmod +x lines.x86" and "chmod +x lines.x86_64".

Thank you everybody for support and feedback. 

Best regards,
Nestor Yavorskyy
